tasks.name: Door
tasks.instruction: Pull the door handle to open the door: the hinge angle must exceed 0.3 rad (door.py:425).

tasks.name: Lift
tasks.instruction: Lift the cube off the table: the cube must end higher than the table top by more than 4 cm (lift.py:433).

tasks.name: NutAssembly
tasks.instruction: Pick up each nut and place it around its matching peg, then move the arm away (nut_assembly.py:622).

tasks.name: NutAssemblyRound
tasks.instruction: Pick up the round nut and place it around the round peg, then move the arm away (nut_assembly.py:622, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: NutAssemblySingle
tasks.instruction: Pick up the single nut and place it around its matching peg, then move the arm away (nut_assembly.py:622, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: NutAssemblySquare
tasks.instruction: Pick up the square nut and place it around the square peg, then move the arm away (nut_assembly.py:622, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: PickPlace
tasks.instruction: Pick up each object and drop it into its matching bin, then move the arm away (pick_place.py:737).

tasks.name: PickPlaceBread
tasks.instruction: Pick up the bread and drop it into the correct bin, then move the arm away (pick_place.py:737, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: PickPlaceCan
tasks.instruction: Pick up the can and drop it into the correct bin, then move the arm away (pick_place.py:737, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: PickPlaceCereal
tasks.instruction: Pick up the cereal box and drop it into the correct bin, then move the arm away (pick_place.py:737, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: PickPlaceMilk
tasks.instruction: Pick up the milk carton and drop it into the correct bin, then move the arm away (pick_place.py:737, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: PickPlaceSingle
tasks.instruction: Pick up the single object and drop it into its matching bin, then move the arm away (pick_place.py:737, single_object_mode).

tasks.name: Stack
tasks.instruction: Stack cube A on top of cube B: A is lifted above the table, released by the gripper and in contact with B (stack.py:268,485).

tasks.name: ToolHang
tasks.instruction: Assemble the frame and hang the tool on its hook so the tool rests on the frame without the robot holding it (tool_hang.py:597,661).

tasks.name: TwoArmHandover
tasks.instruction: Hand the hammer from one arm to the other: the receiving arm holds the handle, the giving arm has released it and the hammer is lifted above the table (two_arm_handover.py:545).

tasks.name: TwoArmLift
tasks.instruction: Both arms lift the pot together: the pot bottom must rise more than 10 cm above the table (two_arm_lift.py:490).

tasks.name: TwoArmPegInHole
tasks.instruction: Insert the peg into the hole: the peg must be aligned with the hole axis and inserted to the right depth (two_arm_peg_in_hole.py:488).

tasks.name: TwoArmTransport
tasks.instruction: Carry the payload into the target bin and the trash into the trash bin (two_arm_transport.py:596).

tasks.name: Wipe
tasks.instruction: Wipe the table clean: every dirt marker must be wiped (wipe.py:698).
